text:
anya: Quick sync — planning to enable ff_cache_batch_coalesce=v2 for /generate (latency-priority) starting a canary at 1% traffic on 2026-03-18T13:00Z. Need sign-off on rollback criteria, perf checks, and audience exclusions.

sam: +1 to canary but suggest preflight: 30m load test at target QPS, compare p95 and 5xxs. Also exclude internal traffic. Config example: ```flag: ff_cache_batch_coalesce
audience: canary
percent: 1
filters: not user.group=internal```

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued #3456 by sam — scheduled 2026-03-18T13:00Z. Watch logs: https://kibana.company/jobs/3456

ops: Rollback criteria proposal: error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency +>15% (relative) for two consecutive 5m windows -> immediate rollback. Also alarm if GPU utilization >85% on GPUPool-3 for >10m.

mike: I'll own runbook during canary and watch traces + latency dashboard. Can we set tracing sample=100% for canary traffic?

lucy: Quick validation commands: `curl -H \"X-FF: ff_cache_batch_coalesce=on\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}' https://api.redwood/generate -v` and compare with off. I can script a small smoke runner to post p50/p95 and errors.

anya: Added rollback playbook on Confluence: https://confluence.company/rollbacks/cachebatch. Steps: disable flag -> drain in-flight -> force-fallback path -> monitor 15m. Who's primary oncall at 13:00Z?

ops: @mike primary, @sam backup. I'll create a temporary dashboard and attach alerts (p95 change, 5xx, gpu-util).

sam: Note: ensure audience excludes admin/internal traffic and test harness IP ranges. Also confirm we don't route traffic to dedicated customers during canary.

mike: Ack. I'll run smoke queries 1m after deploy and post metrics to this thread every 5m.

lucy: Does v2 change KV prefetch TTL? I assume no but want explicit confirmation.

sam: TTL unchanged — v2 only changes coalescing behavior and the coalesce window heuristics.

anya: OK proceeding with us-east-1 only, canary 1% at 13:00Z. I'll kick off and monitor. Pinging this thread for updates every 5m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 2026-03-18T13:00:12Z job #3456. Canary audience: 1% (exclude internal).

mike: 13:05 UTC — p95 +3% relative, errors 0.02% (under threshold). Traces look normal so far.

mike: 13:10 UTC — p95 +18% relative, sustained over 2 windows. Errors up to 0.4%. I'm triggering rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by mike — disabling ff_cache_batch_coalesce for canary. Rollback complete 2026-03-18T13:12:47Z.

anya: Thanks — looks like an edge-case on very short prompts caused coalesce to add extra latency. @sam can you open an issue and tag eng-runtime?

sam: Created issue #7890: "coalesce: latency regression on short prompt distribution" and assigned to eng-runtime. Added initial perf diffs and example traces.

mike: Suggest adding a preflight that samples short prompts at a higher rate (<=10 tokens) and checks latency delta.

lucy: I'll add short-prompt fixtures to the perf harness and re-run tests.

ops: Logs and artifacts kept at https://kibana.company/jobs/3456 (retention 90d). Temporary dashboard will be archived in the runbook.

anya: Closing the canary for now. Good catch, everyone. We'll iterate on v2 and rehearse with added short-prompt tests before the next attempt. :white_check_mark:
